brief.headline: What the job boards say this week
brief.paragraph: NVIDIA: owning the network between gpus (28 → 198 new roles per 13 weeks (7.1×)). Anthropic: scaling the sales machine (89 → 195 new roles per 13 weeks (2.2×)). OpenAI: building hardware devices (20 → 34 new roles per 13 weeks (1.7×)).
bullets: NVIDIA: owning the network between gpus (28 → 198 new roles per 13 weeks (7.1×)).
Anthropic: scaling the sales machine (89 → 195 new roles per 13 weeks (2.2×)).
OpenAI: building hardware devices (20 → 34 new roles per 13 weeks (1.7×)).

text.headline: Anthropic: scaling the sales machine
text.lede: Anthropic has 673 open roles, +56% in six months. The clearest signal is scaling the sales machine: 89 → 195 new roles per 13 weeks (2.2×), concentrated in San Francisco and New York. Unannounced new cities: Delhi, Austin, Mumbai.

sales_push.title: Scaling the sales machine
sales_push.reading: A growing sales force means the company is chasing revenue in new segments or regions.

government.title: Selling to government and defense
government.reading: Security-clearance and public-sector roles point to contracts with government and defense customers, which need cleared staff on site.
